notes: pbteen.com is A-only (no AAAA) AND Akamai/WAF returns 403 'Restricted Access' to direct requests, to translate.goog and to a public NAT64 gateway. Working path was the r.jina.ai reader proxy, which renders the WSI SPA and exposes the storefront's own item-count header. Every qty is that rendered header ('N Items' under the H1, or the 'View N Items' control on pages that use that variant) as of 2026-08-07. Constructor.io (ac.cnstrc.com, key from __INITIAL_STATE__, reachable via NAT64) was used ONLY to discover the category tree - its total_num_results is INFLATED on WSI exactly as the coordinator warned: Table & Desk Lamps 72 vs rendered 68, Sconces 18 vs 16, Wall Mirrors 45 vs 42, Ceiling 47 vs 46, Neon 48 vs 47, Vanity Mirrors 45 vs 44, Shelving & Hooks 78 vs 75, Picture Frames 18 vs 17. No Constructor number was used as a qty. Scope: PB Teen is furniture/bedding/textile-led, so the in-scope decor tree is deliberately short. Excluded as out of scope or as mixed roll-ups: 'Clocks & Desk Accessories' (/shop/accessories/decor-desk-acc/, 108 items) - the site's own H1 is 'Teen Desk Accessories' and it is predominantly functional desk accessories, so it was dropped rather than padded even though clocks are in scope this batch (PB Teen has no clock-only category); 'Plants & Planters' (faux plants); 'Pinboards & Photo Display'; 'Wallpaper & Decals'; 'Sports Decor & Display'; 'Minted' (designer partner); pillows/throws, storage, jewelry & beauty, bath, games/electronics, backpacks & water bottles, holiday. Aggregate/marketing pages (All Lighting, All Decor, All Room Decor, All Mirrors, All Wall Art & Decor, In-Stock, Best Sellers, Sale, New, Dorm shops) were not extracted as leaves. /shop/accessories/canvas-wall-art/ renders the identical 'Prints & Canvas Art' listing as /shop/accessories/art-category/ - deduplicated to one record.
